title: Total RNA Isolation from Bulk Tissue or Isolated Cells
author: Brad Godfrey
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8dehs3e
materials: NEBNext® Ultra™ II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit

For total RNA/DNA extraction use “AllPrep DNA/RNA Micro Kit” (# 80284) from Qiagen following respective protocol. Use optional Beta-ME for glomerular compartment. Note : Elute RNA in 16 µL H 2 O in nucleotide low-binding tubes (Eppendorf #022431021) and store at -80 °C . Note : Keep first flow-through (< 80 bases) for future analysis of small RNAs . Quality and quantity were measured using Agilent Bioanalyzer 2100 Elute RNA in 16uL

steps.title: Sample Collection and Storage
steps.instruction: Transfer the biopsy into a 1.8 mL polypropylene cryotube containing 1.0 mL RNAlater.

substeps.instruction: Use color coding cap inserts to indicate the biopsy origin.
Store the sample at -20 °C until RNA extraction.

steps.title: Tissue Microdissection
steps.instruction: Perform microdissection of the glomeruli or tubulointerstitium.

substeps.instruction: Store the dissected tissue portion in less than 50 µL RNAlater solution.
Store at -20 °C until total RNA extraction.

steps.title: RNA Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the RNA library using the NEBNext® Ultra™ II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina® (rRNA depletion workflow).

steps.title: Sequencing
steps.instruction: Sequence the library using a NovaSeq 6000 (The University of Michigan Advanced Genomics Core).
